sisi.depan: The far wall is dominated by a grand, non-Roman arched gateway of polished black metal leading to the main academy hall, flanked by two floor-to-ceiling teak panels intricately carved with geometric patterns that pulse with light from internal data conduits.
sisi.kanan: The curved right wall features a recessed observation alcove with a low, carved teak railing, containing a holographic projection table that displays swirling energy patterns.
sisi.belakang: Behind the camera position is a single wide entryway into the chamber, bordered by two large, black stone urns inlaid with the golden Galians crest from which a faint, cool mist emanates.
sisi.kiri: The curved left wall contains a set of sliding secondary doors made of dark metal with a gold-trimmed parang batik motif, located next to a wall-mounted control console housed in polished dark wood.

tengah: In the center of the chamber, a colossal, multi-faceted atomic crystal several times taller than a person floats high above a recessed circular pool of roiling golden plasma, and a dark metal catwalk with a perforated floor forms a complete ring around this central feature.
atas: A vast, domed ceiling is constructed with a tiered structure of dark metal beams reminiscent of a joglo roof, with a large, circular energy vent glowing with a faint blue light at its apex directly above the crystal.
